headline: GM trims 500-600 IT jobs, with AI one factor
body: A quiet day with one small story. General Motors cut 500 to 600 roles, mostly in IT, and a person familiar told CNBC that AI played a part, though not the only one. That is a slight hit to Shared Prosperity, so Egalitarian Utopia dipped. Older stories kept fading by hundredths. Horizon Balance reads +2.10.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Egalitarian Utopia -0.06, from GM's IT job cuts (-0.06); Protector God -0.02, from fading earlier news (-0.02).
